limits: Native product models/device/export work differ; native latency ratios are not framework speedups.
Exact source frames are primary; identical static-image content is a predeclared supplementary score.
Three/five repeats quantify this host and fixed corpus; they do not increase independent sample count or prove a population confidence interval.
1/4-image prefix points are single runs on nested image subsets; no isolated throughput scaling law.
EgoWorld FreiHAND side is a right-hand task prior; native predicts side. Do not generalize side accuracy.
MPJPE averages are conditional on matched detections; coverage, PCK and qualified counts keep all GT in the denominator.
Additional predictions are false positives for this single-target output task, not an independent annotation audit of every background hand.
All root coordinates use model-prior scale; no measured world-scale accuracy is established.
Physical 2–16 GPU results are unavailable; server placement benefits remain hypotheses.
